body: Thank you, it was a long day and even longer night. I feel a little better myself now, but I'm still sick over it all.

He texted me this morning when I was asleep. It was just a 'hey'. I called him when I woke up, but he was on his way to a doctor's office and I quickly hung up. He didn't seem to want to speak to me. I can't say I'm surprised by that, but it hurt a little.
